reviews.body: Thanks for tracking down the temperature issue and covering the matcher. I left one inline request: please keep this PR scoped to that fix and move the unrelated stream_options behavior change into a separate PR. Once that is separated, I am happy to take another look.

Verified on this head: the contract test (42 models × nil/zero/configured temperature) fails on main and passes here; ai and agent AI-importer tests pass 5/5 on head and main; sdk-go patch coverage 100%; a local recording server showed temperature omitted only for the documented rejecters, 5/5.

For clarity, the requested change is to remove the stream_options addition from this PR and send it separately. That makes the temperature regression fix straightforward to validate and merge.

Thanks for the review. I checked the diff against the current base: this PR only touches `rejectsTemperature` and `marshalRequest` (temperature) plus their tests in `model_params.go` / `model_params_test.go`. The `stream_options` behaviour (`StreamOptions{IncludeUsage: true}`, with its `TestStreamComplete_WireBody_*` tests) was merged separately in #1134 and is already on `main`, so it is only visible as unchanged context here, not as an addition. If you see a specific `stream_options` line in the diff, please point me to it and I'll drop it right away.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

Took this over to get it merged today, and pushed 5db95e2 on top of your commit.

- **stream_options:** this PR doesn't add or change any stream_options behaviour. It only shows up in a diff hunk header, which names the existing `TestComplete_WireBody_NoStreamOptions` test that the new tests are appended after. Main's stream_options code and tests are untouched.
- **Narrower matcher:** GPT-5.1, 5.2 and 5.4 default to reasoning effort `none` and accept `temperature` (OpenAI's latest-model guide). The blanket `gpt-5*` match would have silently dropped a caller's temperature on those. The matcher now covers the o-series, `gpt-5`, the GPT-5 variants documented to reject temperature, and Claude Opus 4.7+ / Claude 5. Every other model behaves exactly as it does today.
- **Verified:**
  - The contract test (42 models × nil/zero/configured temperature, plus a check that the caller's `Request` isn't mutated) fails on main and passes here.
  - `go test -race -count=5 ./ai` and the `./agent` AI importers pass 5/5 on both this head and main.
  - sdk-go patch coverage is 100%.
  - A local recording server saw no `temperature` for o3-mini and gpt-5, and kept it for gpt-4o and gpt-5.1, across `Complete`, `CompleteWithMessages` and `StreamComplete`, 5/5.
